notes: Source version: published Journal of Consumer Research article, pp. 223–238, supplied licensed EBSCO PDF with JSTOR provenance footer; title and DOI match. Frozen supplied text used. Text extraction encodes equals as p, less-than as !, and minus as ⫺; numeric values preserve printed precision and mathematical signs are transcribed. Replication and reported_success are unassigned placeholders. The reported 179 is the whole ANOVA analytic sample, not an established condition-specific participant count; target-condition n is therefore null. No subgroup n inferred from t degrees of freedom.
